raw_result.task_text: Clear all main tables and counters

central_instructions.R1: Clear all light objects from the main tables and counters in the kitchen by picking them up and passing them to R2 if needed.
central_instructions.R2: Assist R1 in clearing light objects from the main tables and counters in the kitchen by receiving and relocating objects as necessary.
central_instructions.R3: Clear all light objects from the main tables and counters in the living room by picking them up and passing them to R4 if needed.
central_instructions.R4: Assist R3 in clearing light objects from the main tables and counters in the living room by receiving and relocating objects as necessary.
